definitions.gloss: embarrassed smile; bashful laugh; sheepish grin
definitions.explanation: a smile or laugh that comes from feeling embarrassed, shy, or self-conscious

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{照|て}れ{笑|わら}い⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{褒|ほ}められて→褒める：01204_homeru⟧{照|て}れ{笑|わら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浮|う}かべた→浮かべる：13314_ukaberu⟧。
examples.english: She gave a bashful smile when complimented.

examples.japanese: ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掻|か}き→掻く：09647_kaku⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧{照|て}れ{笑|わら}い⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かわいい→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧。
examples.english: The way they scratch their head while laughing bashfully is cute.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{照|て}れる→照れる：08152_tereru⟧ (to be embarrassed) + ⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧ (smile, laugh)

USAGE:
This is generally a positive or endearing expression, suggesting modesty or shyness rather than discomfort. It often accompanies receiving praise or attention.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {照|て}れ{笑|わら}い⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to smile bashfully
- {照|て}れ{笑|わら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浮|う}かべる→浮かべる：13314_ukaberu⟧ - to wear an embarrassed smile

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{苦笑|にがわら}い→苦笑い：08357_nigawarai⟧ - bitter/wry smile
- ⟦{薄笑|うすわら}い→薄笑い：08455_usuwarai⟧ - smirk
- ⟦{愛想笑|あいそうわら}い→愛想笑い：08358_aisouwarai⟧ - polite smile
